note:
SCOPE. Rooms photographed for the room. This topic ranks the SETTING, not the cooking, and the article must say so plainly - several of these kitchens are ordinary and one of them is a chain cafe. Guides about the food live in their own topics; special-occasion-restaurants-london and historic-pubs-dining-rooms-london cover the overlapping venues from a booking and a heritage angle respectively, which is why this is a separate question rather than a competing page.

TIER ORDER IS INVERTED HERE. On every other topic social is the weakest evidence. Here it is the subject: a room all over TikTok IS a photogenic room. That makes the gap below worse than it would be elsewhere, not better.
knownGaps: NO TIER A. No judged award for London restaurant interiors surfaced. The Restaurant & Bar Design Awards is international and design-trade rather than reader-facing, and did not return usable London results. This corpus rests entirely on editorial and blog consensus.

NO TIER D OR E. APIFY_TOKEN is not configured in this environment, so YouTube and TikTok could not be collected properly, and Reddit is blocked to the fetcher. Searching for creators returned only more blog posts, and no channel URL was recorded rather than reconstructing one - see trap 5. audit-source-mix will fail this topic on the social floor, correctly.

BLOG TIER OUTWEIGHS EDITORIAL, four to three. Two mastheads that should be here refused the fetcher: visitlondon.com and thehandbook.com both returned 403. thatsup.co.uk is on the permanent-403 list already.
This topic dates faster than any other on the site. Flower walls are seasonal and installations get replaced, so the checked-on date matters more here than on a food guide.
